edu.name: Okapi Edu
edu.subtitle: Global Next-Gen Learning Operating System
edu.tagline: The global infrastructure SaaS for schools and universities.
edu.description: A unified platform bringing administration, pedagogy, finance, decision-making AI, and student portals together across more than 45 countries.
edu.fullDescription: Okapi Edu is the global education management platform built by Okapi Edge. It orchestrates the full learning lifecycle — from multi-currency enrollment to cryptographically signed report cards — while integrating international and local financial gateways (Stripe, SWIFT, Mobile Money).

aiAnalytics.title: AI Academic Analytics
aiAnalytics.desc: Real-time behavioral and academic analysis to optimize every learner’s journey.

financial.title: Multi-Currency Financial Engine
financial.desc: Automated fee management, instant bank reconciliation, and local tax compliance.

multiCampus.title: Global Multi-Campus Management
multiCampus.desc: Global oversight for school and university networks with territorial sovereignty rules.

studentApp.title: Student Portal & Native PWA App
studentApp.desc: Seamless access, multilingual notifications, and real-time tracking on mobile, web, and desktop.

syntix.name: Syntix Pharma
syntix.subtitle: Global Intelligent Healthcare ERP
syntix.tagline: The international pharmaceutical ERP that secures the supply chain and anticipates demand.
syntix.description: Steer your pharmacies, distribution networks, and health inventories with predictive modeling, Datamatrix traceability, and global e-DGI / fiscal compliance.
syntix.fullDescription: Syntix Pharma by Okapi Edge is the international reference healthcare ERP. It secures the pharmaceutical supply chain, enforces anti-counterfeit traceability, anticipates stockouts with contextual AI, and delivers fully automated real-time fiscal compliance.

invoicing.title: Instant Invoicing & Compliance
invoicing.desc: Cryptographic signature and transmission to fiscal authorities in under 100 ms.

fefo.title: FEFO & Sensitive Lot Traceability
fefo.desc: Strict First-Expired, First-Out handling to block expired products and secure the cold chain.

predictive.title: Predictive Stock Intelligence
predictive.desc: AI models forecasting epidemic and seasonal demand spikes at both global and regional levels.

antiCounterfeit.title: GS1 Scan Anti-Counterfeiting
antiCounterfeit.desc: Instant Datamatrix validation of pharmaceutical products at reception and point of sale.

pos.name: Okapi POS
pos.subtitle: Universal Retail Edge Infrastructure
pos.tagline: Check out, sync, and manage your global retail operations without interruption.
pos.description: An ultra-fast point-of-sale platform built in Rust & Tauri, running 100% offline and synchronized across global cloud nodes.
pos.fullDescription: Okapi POS redefines modern checkout systems at international scale. Engineered to withstand network outages through its Offline-First engine and sub-millisecond execution speed, Okapi POS accepts bank cards, contactless payments, crypto assets, and mobile gateways.

native.title: High-Speed Native Executable
native.desc: Lightweight Tauri / Rust architecture delivering maximum fluidity on tablets, registers, and mobile devices.

syncCrdt.title: Offline-First CRDT Synchronization
syncCrdt.desc: Sales continue without internet. Resynchronization happens automatically the moment connectivity returns.

multiStore.title: Multi-Store & Warehouse Management
multiStore.desc: Global oversight of inventory, inter-site transfers, and financial reporting in real time.

dynamicFiscal.title: Dynamic Invoicing & Fiscal Context
dynamicFiscal.desc: Automatic adaptation to local taxes, VAT, e-DGI, and international accounting standards.

detail.featuresTitle: Checkout Engine & Sync for Okapi POS

hospitals.name: Okapi Hospitals (HIS)
hospitals.subtitle: Integrated Hospital Information System
hospitals.tagline: Run all your hospitals, emergency units, and electronic patient records.
hospitals.description: A turnkey solution for hospitals, clinics, and health centers: shared electronic medical record (EMR), bed management, hospital pharmacy, PACS imaging, and medical billing.
hospitals.fullDescription: Okapi Hospitals (HIS) is the hospital management software platform designed to streamline the patient journey and optimize medical resources. From emergency triage to operating theater and pharmacy management, Okapi Hospitals ensures precise medical follow-up and absolute confidentiality of health data.

emr.title: Electronic Patient Record (EPR)
emr.desc: Centralized medical history, prescriptions, vital signs, and clinical reports in real time.

beds.title: Admissions & Bed Management
beds.desc: Dynamic tracking of room occupancy, on-call scheduling, and inter-department transfers.

pharmacy.title: Hospital Pharmacy & Inventory
pharmacy.desc: Precise medication stock management, consumables traceability, and expiration alerts.

billing.title: Billing & Coverage
billing.desc: Direct integration with insurers, mutual funds, and fiscal gateways for simplified billing.

fueloils.name: Okapi FuelOils
fueloils.subtitle: Downstream Oil & Fuel Management Platform
fueloils.tagline: Steer your service-station networks, dispensers, and fuel depots.
fueloils.description: A global solution for fuel distribution: real-time tank telemetry, fuel-card management, pump automation, and anti-fraud controls.
fueloils.fullDescription: Okapi FuelOils is the platform dedicated to petroleum-product distributors and service-station networks. It connects dispensers, tank gauges, and checkout systems to provide full visibility into fuel flows, prevent losses, and simplify accounting.

telemetry.title: Tank Telemetry & Gauging
telemetry.desc: Continuous monitoring of fuel levels and automatic detection of leaks or anomalies.

fleet.title: Fleet & Prepaid Card Management
fleet.desc: SaaS for enterprise card management with spending caps, time restrictions, and geofencing.

pumps.title: Dispenser Automation
pumps.desc: Direct connection to pumps for automatic recording of every transaction — no manual entry.

multiStation.title: Multi-Station Supervision
multiStation.desc: Centralized dashboard to analyze sales, inventory, and margins across the entire network.
